description: Internal message to request system mode changes

custom_methods.name: getModeString
custom_methods.body: const char* modes[] = {"STARTING_UP", "STANDBY", "VIEWFINDER", "CALIBRATION", "LAUNCH_MONITOR", "DIAGNOSTIC"}; return (new_mode_ >= 0 && new_mode_ <= 5) ? modes[new_mode_] : "UNKNOWN";

notes: Enhanced version of original ChangeModeMsg with additional context fields
Includes reason and requesting agent for better traceability
Compatible with existing SystemMode_Type enum values
